integrity: The structural proof is self-contained apart from the standard Kronecker character theorem. The cited seven-dimensional counterexample and its numerical value were not independently verified and are not premises of the structural theorem. Supplementary finite numerical checks cannot certify universal density.
scientific_limitations: The new theorem concerns finite-spectrum positive-positive-definite exponential polynomials; Gram matrices are approximated, not exactly matched. It does not apply to all general continuous positive-positive-definite functions, nor to integer-periodic-only one-variable polynomials. The 2026 source full text was inaccessible, leaving priority uncertainty.
title: One-dimensional Schwartz universality for finite doubly positive Gram data
